//: sonar-project.properties takes sonar.cpd.exclusions from ignore below, each entry translated into a Sonar pattern by scripts/sync-config.mjs: change the entries here.
packages/preact/src/**: the Preact adapter, a deliberate parallel of the React one.
packages/hash-plugin/src/**: a deliberate parallel of browser-plugin.

packages/*/src/dom-utils/**, browser-env/** and shared-ssr/**: symbolic links to directories of shared/, which is scanned itself. Neither jscpd nor Sonar reads a file through them; the entries keep it so.
packages/*/src/**/*.react-server.ts and packages/react/src/legacy.ts, legacy.ssr.ts and ink.ts: entry points of other subpaths and export conditions, which re-export what the main entry does.
packages/validation-plugin/src/type-guards/** and shared/browser-env/state-guard.ts: twins copied by design, which scripts/tests/twin-lockstep.test.mjs keeps in step.
**/*.d.ts: declaration files, which hold types and no code that runs, and which SonarJS leaves out by default.
